error_analysis.false_positives: Minor foliage shadows along property boundaries misclassified as compound wall edges.
error_analysis.false_negatives: Low contrast roof sections under dense tree overhangs in test frames 15-20.
error_analysis.small_object_failures: 170x153 pixel frame tile scale prevents small structure segmentation (staircase, awning, veranda).
error_analysis.boundary_errors: Polygon vertex variance of 2-4 pixels along outer building edge margins.

limitations: The current images are approximately 170x153 storyboard-derived tiles. Phase 3 and Phase 4 evaluations establish that small structure classes (staircase, shop_extension, veranda, awning) require high-resolution raw UAV drone survey imagery (>1080p).
